title: List down two molecule id of triple bond non carcinogenic molecules with el
question:
List down two molecule id of triple bond non carcinogenic molecules with element carbon.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: carbon refers to element = 'c'; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
JOIN atom a ON c.XCL_007 = a.XCL_001
WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
  AND m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'c'
LIMIT 2;
